BOTANICAL GARDEN CABLE CAR - ROUND TRIP This journey will start and end at the same station and the total ride time will take around 18 minutes. You can get out in the middle of the journey to visit the station and the surrounding area and then you can continue your ride back to the station from where you started your journey. ONE WAY ROUND TRIP Adult 11.00€ 16.00€ Child (7 - 14 years) 6.00€ 9.00€ Get your ticket Cable Car & Botanical Garden CABLE CAR & BOTANICAL GARDEN - ONE WAY The journey will be made from one station to the other, i.e. from the station at Jardim Botânico to the station at Monte OR vice versa and will take approximately 9 minutes. Also includes entrance to the Botanical Garden. CABLE CAR & BOTANICAL GARDEN - ROUND TRIP This journey also includes entrance to the Botanical Garden and will start and end at the same station and will take around 18 minutes. You can get out in the middle of the journey to visit the station and its surroundings and then continue back to the station where you started your journey. ONE WAY ROUND TRIP Adult 19.00€ 24.00€ Child (7 - 14 years) 9.00€ 12.00€ The visit to the Botanical Garden takes about 1h30-2 hours MTA - Transportes Alternativos da Madeira S.A Caminho das Voltas, 15 9060-329 Funchal +351 291 210 290 Home Technical Features Use Regulations Privacy Policy Complaints Book Dev eloped by Navega Bem
